title: Reproducibility materials for Why multifunctional structures persist under conflicting selection
description: Reproducibility materials accompanying the theory manuscript 'Why multifunctional structures persist under conflicting selection'. The package contains the manuscript source, theory notes, figure sources, executable model/process implementation, claim verifier, regression tests, anonymity audit, and checksum manifest. The manuscript distinguishes three causes of persistent multifunctionality under documented conflict: differentiation may not pay, may be locally inaccessible, or may fail to establish when rare.
